notes.title: Undusted: Letters from the Past is Coming on October 13th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938404/3eee2b8e058ad197f0d570c66b265a3ac5feb3a4.png[/img]

🌻Hello, everyone!

We hope you are doing well! As we mentioned in the previous Steam announcement, we will announce the release date real soon. Today, we’re excited to finally share it with you! 

[b]Undusted: Letters from the Past will be coming to Steam on October 13, 2025[/b]

[h3]Check out the release date trailer here![/h3]
[previewyoutube=cM9Qrs3i8Lw;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]A short message from us 💌[/h3]
With the release just around the corner, our game director, producer, and lead artist, [b]Yoonjeong Choi[/b], wanted to share a few heartfelt words with you!

“I feel both excited and nervous. My biggest hope is that those who have been waiting for Undusted won’t be let down, and that it can be a game where many people find comfort and joy. We put a lot of effort into making every interaction, especially the sound design, deeply satisfying. If you play while paying attention to the sounds, I think you’ll enjoy it even more.

“And unlike other cleaning games, Undusted blends objects and narrative very closely together. As you clean, the story naturally unfolds, so players who enjoy emotional storytelling will likely find it a meaningful experience.

“Since we first opened Undusted’s Steam store page, people have continuously discovered the game, played the demo, and shared their feedback. Those reactions have had a huge influence on development, and we’re truly grateful for that, and I hope we can give back with a game that feels truly worthwhile.”

[b]If you haven’t tried it yet, the demo is available! ✨[/b]
Try the Undusted: Letters from the Past demo while you wait for the full release. Cozy up, relax, and join Adora as she cleans, restores, and polishes cherished objects from her past. 

[h3]Play the demo now and wishlist the game![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2891020/Undusted_Letters_from_the_Past/

Once again, thank you so much for your support.
We’ll see you soon on the launch day!

notes.title: Devlog #1: How We Started Making Undusted
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938404/ff71e5c6009d75492820b94bb493a611d45c0509.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]🌻Hello everyone! We’re here with our very first devlog.[/p][p]Today, we’d like to share a little bit about the process of making Undusted.[/p][p][/p][h2]
[b]So, what did our team make before this…?[/b][/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2441270/Kill_The_Crows/"][/dynamiclink]It was [b]Kill The Crows[/b]! [/p][p]Quite a different mood compared to Undusted, right? [/p][p]We’ve heard that a lot, and honestly, even we thought it might feel a bit unexpected to others.[/p][p][/p][p]Our team is small, but made up of people who each want to create their own unique games![/p][p]Because of that, we naturally end up challenging ourselves with different genres. [/p][p]And the game we’re preparing after Undusted will be another new genre as well, so please look forward to it![/p][p][/p][h2]
[b]What led us to create Undusted?[/b][/h2][p]At one point, we were really into ASMR and “Oddly Satisfying” videos. [/p][p]The kind of things that steal away your time when you just zone out watching them![/p][p]As we got absorbed in those, one day we had this thought:[/p][p][/p][p][b]What if we made a game that could give players that same sensation?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]It already feels good just to watch, but wouldn’t it be even better if you could actually interact with it?[/p][p]That’s how we made our prototype and decided to start the project![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938404/ba7a441034fbb9b221cd0b8d81e748ebbf724a86.gif"][/img][/p][p](A toothbrush from the very first prototype)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938404/cbb14ee5e42f4336890d92ab116b56deb59ea1ea.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938404/f4271742932f453fa71f493d30762582c577da2b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938404/c6dacd0aef7302767dad3c5aeb33b61da0fc04b5.png"][/img]( Early development shots of Undusted! )[/p][p][/p][p]There were many difficult moments while making the game, but what kept us going was our belief in it.[/p][p]And that belief grew stronger thanks to the support and reactions of players like you. [/p][p]Thank you so much for being with us throughout this not-so-short journey.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]We will announce the release date soon! Please stay tuned![/b][/h3][p]We can’t wait to share the game with you and hear your thoughts.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Follow us and be the first to check out the upcoming release date![/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2891020/Undusted_Letters_from_the_Past/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]You can also follow us on social media![/p][p]🐦[url="https://x.com/undustedgame"]https://x.com/undustedgame[/url][/p][p]📷 [url="https://www.instagram.com/undustedgame/"]https://www.instagram.com/undustedgame/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]  [/p][h3]Join the community![/h3][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//41124308/e565fd8faadca2dec71f42166fbf7a66cec63a48.png"][/img][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//41124308/2b28706cd5011db32da556bf6d3904e2bac01201.png"][/img][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//41124308/189cd02729137419677e69173cf1602a0c487386.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update! - Includes a New Item and Other Small Changes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938404/c12cecaf730144fda5d35172efef83396cff326a.png[/img]

Hello, everyone! How have you been?  
We've been spending a lot of time making more things dirty! 
We can't wait to introduce you to these new items soon!

We’ve updated our demo as part of the Wholesome Games Celebration! 
By visiting the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames]Wholesome Games Celebration[/url] link, you can discover cozy games on sale and explore new releases!

Now, let’s go over what’s changed in the demo!

[h2]Key New Features[/h2]

[b]A New Item Has Been Added![/b]
[list]
[*] What is this shiny little object? Find out in the demo!
[/list]
[b]Cleaning Toggle Mode Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Tired of sore wrists? With this new feature, you can clean items much more comfortably.
[*] Now, after pressing the left mouse button, you only need to move the mouse to clean, without holding down the button.
[*] Enable the Cleaning Toggle Mode in the settings!
[/list]
[b]Increased Hold Time for Tapping[/b]
[list]
[*] We heard your feedback about the inconvenience of constant tapping, so we’ve extended the hold time.
[*] Also, we’ve removed the annoying tapping sound that was hurting your ears.
[/list]

[h2]Miscellaneous Tweaks[/h2]

[b]Bug Report Feature Added[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now report bugs directly from the settings menu when you encounter issues.
[*] This helps us understand exactly when and where problems occur, making the game even better with your help!
[/list]
[b]Warning for PCs Not Meeting Minimum Specs[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve added a warning message in the bottom left corner for computers that do not meet the minimum requirements.
[/list]
[b]Tool Sound Effects Updated[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve changed the sound effects for the tools.
[/list]
[b]Improved Cleaning Efficiency[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the number of hard-to-clean areas on cups with the sponge.
[*] Sponge Adjustments: The sponge is now smaller but cleans a larger area.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where objects would start clean on some computers.
[*] Fixed the Bug Where the Percentage Wouldn’t Increase
[*] Resolved the Issue Where the Sponge Polygon Would Crumple
[/list]

[h2]We Need Your Help![/h2]

[b]Is the Bug Still Occurring After the Patch?[/b]
[list]
[*] Let us know in the community’s new Demo Bug Report thread!
[*] It’s even better if you submit a bug report along with your post.
[*] Link: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2891020/discussions/0/6149188575098876201/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2891020/discussions/0/6149188575098876201/[/url]
[/list]

[b]What’s Bothering You? Share Your Thoughts![/b]
[list]
[*] This demo update was developed based on the feedback you left in the community.
[*] Is there still something that bothers you in the game? Let us know what it is.
[*] Share your feedback in the community’s new Demo Feedback thread.

notes.title: Undusted: Letters from the Past Demo Build Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938404/169679fea7215f6fa5f4f4e49fd1dceff414841c.png[/img]
Hello! This is the development team of Undusted: Letters from the Past.
We are excited to share the first demo of our game with you. You can download and play the demo build from the Steam store page.

[b]📌About the Game[/b]

Undusted: Letters from the Past is a casual game where you clean and restore dirty objects. While developing the game, we focused on providing the following experiences:

[b]1. Gameplay: Mechanically, Visually, and Audibly Satisfying Core Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]The core gameplay revolves around cleaning dirty objects using various methods and tools.
[*]We aim to make this process engaging without being too tedious, repetitive, or overly difficult.
[*]We want players to look forward to discovering diverse objects and learning new interactions and tools needed to restore them as the game progresses.
[/list]
[b]2. Story: Small but Engaging and Touching Narratives[/b]
[list]
[*]Our goal is to deliver stories that, while not grand or epic, are heartfelt and touching.
[*]We hope players will be curious about the stories behind each object and imagine how these objects connect to the progression of the narrative.
[/list]

[b]📌About the Demo Build[/b]

In the demo build, you can experience some of the objects and mechanics featured in the game. 
We hope you enjoy it! 
We would love to hear your thoughts on the game, so please share your feedback in the community.

Thank you!
